properties.text: Ukrainian military observer Kostyantyn Mashovets reported on October 25 that Ukrainian forces liberated Perebudova (east of Oleksandrivka), Komar (south of Perebudova on the opposite bank of the Mokri Yaly River), and Fedorivka (south of Komar).[1] Mashovets reported that Ukrainian forces advanced southwest of Vesele (southwest of Fedorivka) up to Skudne (southeast of Fedorivka).

The Ukrainian General Staff reported that Ukrainian forces struck a Russian Rubikon Center for Advanced Unmanned Technologies manpower concentration near Kamyanka, Zaporizhia Oblast (roughly 31 kilometers from the frontline) on October 22 or overnight on October 22 to 23.[63] Neither Russian nor Ukrainian sources reported ground activity in the Kherson direction on October 23.
